newsitem.title: USA: Arthuis sees no decision on SDRs Monday.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis sees no decision on SDRs Monday.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Sunday he expected a decision soon on a special allocation of IMF Special Drawing Rights (SDRs), but did not expect this to come on Monday.
The International Monetary Fund's policy-making Interim Committee was due to discuss a new allocation of SDRs -- the IMF's currency, which its members draw on in times of need -- on Monday.
"A decision is imminent, but not for tomorrow," Arthuis told reporters after a meeting of the Group of Seven finance ministers and central bankers.
The IMF is considering a one-off allocation of SDRs to provide these to members who joined recently and who do not have access to them. But it has yet to agree the amount.
